reference: Actual frozen GGML graph constructors and CPU executor, one CPU thread. Inputs are encoded only by original GGML quantize_chunk or CPU from_float traits; expected bytes are native contiguous graph outputs. No Rust output used.
notes: COUNT_EQUAL includes source-defined higher-axis index behavior; source offsets outside the declared span are rejected by Rust rather than read.

F32 transcendental comparisons retain 2e-6 + 2e-6*abs(expected). F16/BF16 comparisons additionally allow half of the adjacent output spacing for each final nearest-even conversion. This rounding envelope is derived from two final quantization errors, not from observed maxima; exact UCRT ERF bit parity remains OPEN.

Arithmetic, packed matmul, shape, integer and exhaustive F16 GELU/GELU_QUICK and BF16 GELU cases compare exact output bits. Independent 80-digit ERF accuracy references are separate from this unchanged native-output corpus.

The first 295-case native mismatch capture is preserved externally with SHA256 74d04184c941a9058c5321cc568c7e81c458fbe3dcec9aa8ab64a6dc7ae4fa89; later complete ERF captures preserve every raw original reference value.
Circular left padding larger than the input axis is excluded: the source wraps by (coord + size) % size and can read before the buffer. Rust returns Bounds for that source-undefined case.
Inputs retain their native byte strides and padding. Original context scratch allocation is external to the product.
